data.name: Shanhai: Spirits of Myth
data.detailed_description:
Reimagined Shanhai World – Explore a Living Eastern Fantasy Realm

Inspired by the ancient Chinese mythology of the Classic of Mountains and Seas (Shan Hai Jing), experience a breathtaking open world filled with majestic landscapes, mysterious ruins, and countless secrets.

Travel freely across diverse regions and immerse yourself in a world where nature constantly changes.

  • A vast seamless fantasy world inspired by ancient Chinese myths

  • Dynamic day-and-night cycle with changing weather, including rain, snow, storms, and sandstorms

  • Hidden realms, ancient ruins, and unexpected encounters waiting to be discovered

  • Fly across the skies on your sword and witness the beauty of the Shanhai realm

Ancient Spirit Beasts – Build Bonds with Mythical Companions

The legendary creatures of ancient myths are no longer just stories.

Encounter and tame powerful spirit beasts, nurture their bloodlines, unlock their hidden abilities, and create your own unique companion team. Command legendary creatures such as the Vermilion Bird, Azure Dragon, White Tiger, and Black Tortoise as they fight alongside you.

  • Collect and cultivate a wide variety of spirit beasts

  • Unlock evolution paths and powerful exclusive abilities

  • Develop strategic combinations between your character and spirit companions

  • Journey together with mythical creatures from ancient legends

The Path of Immortality – Create Your Own Cultivation Style

There is no single path to ascension.

Master countless martial arts techniques, celestial spells, and ancient cultivation methods. Seek divine weapons, refine mystical treasures, and combine skills freely to develop your own combat philosophy.

  • Multiple cultivation styles, including swordsmanship, elemental arts, and spirit summoning

  • Deep skill customization and strategic combat combinations

  • Collect rare weapons, artifacts, and legendary equipment

  • Choose your own path toward becoming an immortal

Strategic Battles – Challenge Ancient Evils and Turn the Tide

The greatest enemies of the Shanhai world cannot be defeated by strength alone.

Study your opponents, coordinate spirit abilities with powerful techniques, and adapt your strategy in intense battles against terrifying monsters, ancient demons, and forgotten gods.

  • Fast-paced action combat combined with tactical decision-making

  • Powerful spirit beast skills and cooperative battle systems

  • Epic boss encounters and challenging ancient dungeons

  • Defeat overwhelming enemies through wisdom and strategy

Adventure Together – Unite with Allies Against Legendary Beasts

The road to immortality does not have to be walked alone.

Gather trusted companions, establish powerful clans, explore dangerous realms, and challenge world bosses for legendary treasures and rare resources.

  • Cooperative multiplayer boss raids

  • Clan wars and large-scale faction conflicts

  • Group exploration of dangerous high-level regions

  • Fight alongside your allies and earn glory together
